dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is real-time Hong Kong bus ETA lookup, and the bundled Python scripts match that purpose by querying KMB/Citybus public endpoints, matching route and stop names, and formatting arrival times.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill documents a narrow command allowlist, no-secrets rule, and fixed fallback behavior; however, route, stop, and language values should be passed as separate command arguments rather than interpolated into an unquoted shell string.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no privileged installer or package installation step. The recommended setup runs a bundled Python sync script to build a local SQLite cache from public transit data.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access and local writes are proportionate to transit ETA lookup and caching. One sync URL uses static.data.gov.hk, which is purpose-aligned but broader than the SKILL.md allowlist wording.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to skill-local SQLite/JSON cache files, and the stale-cache background refresh is disclosed. There is no evidence of credential access, broad filesystem indexing, elevated privileges, or destructive behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings: [LP3] expected: The finding is valid as a least-privilege note: shell execution, network access, and local file writes are present. The artifacts disclose them and keep them aligned with bus ETA lookup and skill-local caching, so this does not justify Review by itself.
llm.guidance: Before installing, expect the skill to run local Python scripts, contact Hong Kong public transit/open-data services, and create cache files inside its scripts directory. Do not provide secrets; use normal argument passing for route and stop names to avoid shell quoting issues.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed Hong Kong bus arrival lookup skill that queries public transit data and stores local cache files for faster results.
